_readme: Human-seeded name variants for FMCSA resolution.
The resolver searches both legal_name and dba_name in the FMCSA census, which
handles most brand/registry divergence on its own (e.g. Venture Logistics files
as VENTURE TRANSPORT LLC but lists 'VENTURE LOGISTICS' as a DBA, so it resolves
unaided). Entries are only needed where the operating entity's registered name
shares no searchable token with the company's canonical name.
Every entry here is a documented limit on automation: it is a fact a human had to
supply. Keep the 'why' field populated so the Week 4 reliability review can count
how much human seeding the harness actually required.
usdot_seed pins a resolution outright, bypassing name scoring. Use sparingly and
only for a USDOT number a human has verified against the company's own materials.

C0002.why: Mack Group is the holding-brand name; the FMCSA registrant is its operating subsidiary Mack Molding Company Inc (Arlington VT). No DBA field links them.
